data.additional_information:
Position 1: Assistant Professor
Experience: 0–10 Years
Qualification
B.E./B.Tech and M.E./M.Tech in CSE/IT or relevant specialization with First Class.
Ph.D. in the relevant discipline preferred.
Candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis or are nearing completion may also apply.
NET/SLET qualification will be an added advantage where applicable.
Key Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate and postgraduate courses in Computer Science and allied disciplines.
Teach subjects in one or more of the following domains:
Full Stack Development
Cloud Computing
DevOps
Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
Data Analytics
Cybersecurity
Internet of Things (IoT)
Develop course materials, laboratory manuals, and assessment tools.
Mentor students for projects, internships, and career development.
Participate in curriculum development and accreditation activities.
Publish research papers in reputed journals and conferences.
Apply for research grants and contribute to consultancy activities.
Support departmental and university administrative responsibilities.
Desired Skills
Strong programming skills in Python, Java, C++, JavaScript, or related technologies.
Knowledge of AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, AI/ML tools, Data Analytics platforms, or Cybersecurity frameworks.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work in a multidisciplinary academic environment.
Position 2: Associate Professor
Experience: 11–15 Years
Qualification
B.E./B.Tech and M.E./M.Tech in CSE/IT or relevant specialization with First Class.
Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering or an allied discipline is mandatory.
Proven academic, research, and administrative contributions.
Experience in handling NBA/NAAC accreditation processes will be preferred.
Key Responsibilities
Teach undergraduate, postgraduate, and research-level courses.
Lead academic and research initiatives within the department.
Guide M.Tech and Ph.D. scholars.
Develop industry collaborations, funded research projects, and consultancy assignments.
Publish high-quality research papers in Scopus/Web of Science indexed journals.
Contribute to curriculum design aligned with industry and emerging technology trends.
Mentor junior faculty members and coordinate departmental activities.
Organize FDPs, workshops, conferences, and seminars.
Participate in accreditation, ranking, and quality assurance activities.
Support institutional governance and strategic initiatives.
Preferred Specializations
Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
Generative AI
Data Science & Analytics
Cloud Computing
Cybersecurity
DevOps
Full Stack Engineering
Internet of Things (IoT)
Desired Skills
Strong publication record and research credentials.
Experience in securing funded projects and industry collaborations.
Leadership and team management capabilities.
Excellent communication, mentoring, and stakeholder engagement skills.
